notes.title: No Main Game
notes.content:
Announcement:
We regret to inform you that due to programing errors, collision errors, lack of resources and lack of funding, the main line of chili the chipmunk games have been canceled indeffinetly.
We apologise for this inconvinience and instead will be focusing on the spin off titles as main line titals from now on.
Expect more games like chili the chipmunks pinball adventure in the future, and we hope we can return to the original mainline concepts using a different game engine and cheaper resources in the fare future till then we hope you can continue to enjoy this free ware game.
Thank you understanding.
Head of N J FOX
Nathan John Ashton
